verdict: Approved for the order scope. Weekday: the expanded text has Essa plus the Bible-verse chain under shabbat=false, labelled בחול/On weekdays. Sabbath: Anusah under shabbat=true, labelled bilingually. One shared Ken Tagen follows both in the expanded text. The documentary texts keep the printed weekday and Sabbath Ken Tagen separately, and the English keeps 'On Sabbath.', which matches the image of printed page 137. Then come Teqa, Num 10:10 and Shomea, followed by TARAT under shabbat=false with the blower role. The Hayom/Areshet inclusion and cantor-repeat condition trees match the accepted Zikhronot trees in the evidence file exactly. That includes the optional weekday Areshet repeat and Frankfurt saying and repeating both on the Sabbath, as the page-274 custom rules require. The Areshet variant declare (teqiot_veseder_shofarot=true) is closed by a sibling endDeclare. Retzeh is labelled reader. With priests: congregation says Veteerav and the reader says Sheotekha. Without priests: the standard Vetechezeinah. Modim is reader, Modim derabbanan congregation, then the tail. The full intro has the reader role before its parent. The 'Kohanim aloud' direction is a conditional child (birkat-kohanim=true), in both languages, and labels itself when the condition is unknown. The intro itself is unconditional. Scope nesting is consistent with ancestor-scopes.json, and the chunk closes the repetition declare locally. No material beyond printed page 145 / scan n310 is claimed, and there are no leftover navigation or repeat/skip instructions.
